myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Padmasambhava appears in buddhist tradition as lotus-born, vajrayana, tibet. The name's meaning, "'Lotus-born' (padma 'lotus' + sambhava 'born, arisen'), 'Guru Rinpoche', the tantric master revered as the founder-figure of Tibetan Buddhism.", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Padmasambhava in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Padmasambhava remains a touchstone for understanding buddhist religion, art, and identity.
